# PICOBOOT flashing library

Unmodified MIT-licensed picoflash modules by Piers Finlayson, vendored from
GB-Link/gblink-launcher revision `bac443a78c05476a2b82ebab021ea58747966998`,
directory `assets/js/picoflash/`. LICENSE is included. The adjacent `.d.ts`
files are local declarations. The launcher uses these modules for its own
in-browser RP2040 firmware updater; PkCamp provides its own UI and orchestration.
